owner_outcome.statement: Complete prerequisite designs 1-5 — the Goal A execution runbook, the machine-readable A1-A11 plus A5b cell graph, the five-state common lifecycle, the Codex/Claude/Gemini adapter contract, and a fresh maker-separated Design Flow v2 gate — then advance the frozen Goal A order from A1, proceeding without stopping except for destructive operations or infinite loops, which stop immediately.
owner_outcome.success_boundary: This pack closes when the three committed artifacts validate, the independent gate passes with P0 and P1 at zero, and the candidate receipt is published on issue 307. Non-goals: no A1 implementation, no runtime or fleet change, no merge or deploy, no redefinition of frozen roadmap decisions.

Authorizes prerequisite design 1-5 plus an independent gate, then A1; authorizes zero protected effects and zero implementation now.
Binds maker arc, three allowed paths, exact baseline f7fcd0f1, validators, generation limit 1 plus 1 corrective.

assumptions.statement: The frozen issue body plus its citable amendments are the sole semantic source for cell content; per-cell implementation detail lives in the referenced issues and is bound at each cell's own handoff time.

qa remains the reserved maker-history-external checker; if qa is unavailable another registered evidence_audit_gate seat outside the maker history may be bound by the orchestrator. The gen1 gate ran under this clause (checker devauditor; qa interactive session unavailable) and the substitution is recorded in the gate result.

unknowns.statement: Whether the A5b 187-commit delta contains a DB schema migration is unknown until the machine enumeration in A5b step 1 runs; the conditional owner gate covers both outcomes (GA-28).

inventions.statement: A five-state lifecycle with per-state entry and exit predicates as the single advancement semantics for all 12 cells.
inventions.rationale: The handoff freezes the state names; this pack adds the machine predicates so that EFFECT_PROVEN and CLOSED are measured, never asserted.

inventions.statement: The citation contract (authority requires URL plus raw sha256; missing either is typed-rejected) as a lifecycle-level invariant.
inventions.rationale: Issue 307 names the missing citation contract as design hole C2 and the root of the 2026-08-16 315-tick no-progress incident; the runbook closes it as an enforceable predicate (GA-07).

inventions.statement: Digest-independent no-progress counting, non-terminal state expiry with typed EXPIRED recovery, and BUILT-only post-failure preparation scope.
inventions.rationale: Finding F-02 proved the gen1 distinct-digest counter can miss the canonical same-digest infinite loop and that expiry/recovery was promised but undefined; gen2 defines both as measurable predicates (GA-09, GA-25, GA-29, GA-30).

entities.description: one of the 12 frozen cells (A1..A11, A5b) with control sources, dependencies, and an effect predicate
the machine-readable derived graph binding exact order, owner gates, and the A5b nonterminal rule
a typed state change with authority, evidence identity, and idempotency key
a URL plus raw sha256 pair that makes a decision citable as authority
a transport/format translation record for Codex, Claude, or Gemini carrying the derived core semantic digest
a per cell-operation-subject counter that increments on every zero-transition evaluation and resets on a typed transition record
an expires_at deadline on every non-terminal state record with a typed EXPIRED outcome and recovery actor

values.description: closed set: BUILT, PLACED, ACTIVATED, EFFECT_PROVEN, CLOSED
closed set: DESTRUCTIVE_OP_STOP, NO_PROGRESS_HALT, ORDER_VIOLATION, OWNER_GATE_REQUIRED, CITATION_UNCITABLE, EVIDENCE_NOT_REDERIVABLE, SUBJECT_BINDING_MISMATCH, EXPIRED
closed set: EXECUTED_OFFLINE (readback recorded), COMMITTED_NOT_RUN (first-implementation commitment; never counted as executed evidence)

state_and_event_model.idempotency: one transition per cell id plus state plus evidence digest; duplicates admit zero effects (GA-23); the no-progress counter counts one increment per evaluation event id
state_and_event_model.concurrency: one ACTIVATED work stream per cell measured at or below 1 (GA-24); later cells may pre-build only
state_and_event_model.transaction: a transition records its evidence digest and the new state atomically; a failed evidence write leaves the prior state
state_and_event_model.consistency: the graph file plus issue 307 comments are the durable record; session memory and queue state are never authoritative

decisions.note: subject = frozen issue 307 body digest; author mode; generation 2 is the single authorized corrective bounded to findings F-01..F-04
graph and runbook are the two committed structure artifacts; the semantic core digest re-derives from their exact digests via the declared derivation command
31 predicates map 1:1 to fixtures and edges; 3 fixtures executed offline with output readbacks, 28 recorded as COMMITTED_NOT_RUN in the fixture execution ledger; evidence identity is URL plus sha256
citation contract closes design hole C2; owner gates enumerated including the conditional A5b gate; closure authority is maker-history-external
delivery handoff complete and implementation-inactive until gate pass plus per-cell handoffs; post-failure scope bounded to BUILT-only preparation
terminal admission is machine-measured for every cell effect predicate; A5b nonterminal; halt, expiry, and destructive stops are typed and immediate

failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: a real but stale decision reused; mitigated by freshness binding in the citation

failure_threat_recovery.cause: one adapter starts translating semantics instead of transport
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: adapter change lands without symmetry re-verification
failure_threat_recovery.protected_invariant: one canonical semantic core with a reproducible digest derivation (GA-05, GA-31)
failure_threat_recovery.detection: adapter symmetry check finds digest or semantics divergence; a stale digest fails the derivation comparison
failure_threat_recovery.containment: the diverging adapter is non-authoritative; its transitions block
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: restore transport-only translation, re-run the derivation command, and re-verify symmetry
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: drift in surfaces without fixtures; mitigated by a fixture per adapter capability

failure_threat_recovery.cause: AUN queue close, ACK, or done is treated as cell completion
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: operator or executor reads adapter state as progress
failure_threat_recovery.detection: lifecycle validator rejects adapter-state transitions with a typed reason
failure_threat_recovery.containment: cell state unchanged; the event is recorded as transport evidence only
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: the effect predicate must be measured for real advancement
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: human reporting may still cite ACKs; reports without effect evidence carry no authority

failure_threat_recovery.cause: a transition evidence artifact becomes unreadable or mutated
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: storage loss or edit after recording
failure_threat_recovery.detection: readback re-hash differs from the recorded digest
failure_threat_recovery.containment: the dependent transition blocks with EVIDENCE_NOT_REDERIVABLE
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: re-derive from the source artifact or re-produce the evidence
failure_threat_recovery.rollback: revert the dependent state until evidence re-derives
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: simultaneous source loss; mitigated by publishing evidence to issue 307

failure_threat_recovery.cause: a later cell starts before an earlier cell closes, including A5b substituting A1
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: parallel enthusiasm or misread of the amendment
failure_threat_recovery.protected_invariant: exact_order is the only advancement order; A5b is nonterminal (GA-01, GA-02); post-failure scope is BUILT-only (GA-29)
failure_threat_recovery.detection: order checker finds an open predecessor for the starting cell
failure_threat_recovery.containment: typed ORDER_VIOLATION block with zero effects
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: close the predecessor or obtain a cited owner waiver
failure_threat_recovery.rollback: none; the violating start was blocked
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: waivers accumulating; each waiver requires its own citable decision

failure_threat_recovery.cause: a non-terminal state stalls past its expires_at without any evaluation running
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: orchestrator outage or a forgotten cell
failure_threat_recovery.protected_invariant: expiry produces a typed EXPIRED record with a reachable recovery transition (GA-25)
failure_threat_recovery.detection: a sweep compares the clock against expires_at for every non-terminal state record
failure_threat_recovery.containment: typed EXPIRED recorded once; the cell admits no ordinary advancement until recovery
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: the recovery actor re-plans or publishes one escalation to issue 307, then waits halted
failure_threat_recovery.rollback: none; expiry mutates no prior state
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: the sweep itself stalling; mitigated because any later evaluation of the cell also measures expires_at

operations_migration_rollback.operation: the runbook and graph are docs-only artifacts versioned in git; validators ship under later cell handoffs pinned to this pack digest
operations_migration_rollback.migration: no runtime or data migration exists in this design; A5b's conditional migration case is typed-stopped to an owner gate by design (GA-28)
operations_migration_rollback.rollback: reverting the design branch restores the prior docs state; no runtime effect exists to roll back

findings: owner outcome bound verbatim from the frozen issue body; success boundary, 6 non-goals, 2 assumptions, 1 unknown, and 3 inventions separated with source refs and the corrective scope bounded to findings F-01..F-04

7 entities, 3 closed value sets, 7 invariants, 5 commands, and 2 ownership rows each cite an exact source ref; the 12 cell effect predicates are traced one-to-one as GA-11 through GA-22 so domain meaning is fixture-bound, not paraphrased

the operator journey is typed end to end: owner gates notify once then halt, escalation publishes one comment with position and resume conditions, expiry routes stalled cells to a recovery actor, and every record is an immutable comment url readable by human and machine

3 components and 3 adapters share one semantic core whose digest re-derives from the two artifact digests via a declared command; the design stays docs-only with zero runtime dependencies and independently testable validator seams

state ownership, atomic transition-plus-evidence writes, duplicate replay with zero effects, WIP=1 concurrency, expiry recovery, and durable-record consistency are defined and traced as GA-23, GA-24, GA-25

executor and adapter output is untrusted until validated, prose is never state, secrets are excluded from design artifacts, protected effects are enumerated with owners, and authority requires citable urls plus sha256 so injected text cannot mint authority

9 failure specimens cover both owner-named stop classes plus citation, gate-bypass, drift, substitution, evidence-loss, order, and expiry-stall classes, each with detection, containment, bounded recovery, rollback, and residual risk

evidence identity is url plus raw sha256, reason codes are a closed observable set, issue 307 is the single observation destination, and the fixture execution ledger distinguishes EXECUTED_OFFLINE readbacks from COMMITTED_NOT_RUN commitments so declared and verified are separable by machine

the design budgets bounded counters instead of latency: halt bound 3 evaluations, notification budget 1, retry budget 3, expiry deadline default 7 days, generation budget 1 corrective; every exhaustion behavior is typed and the counters are fixture-measured

artifacts are digest-versioned with the gen1 head recorded as baseline, mixed-revision adapter drift is detected by the semantic core rebinding fixture, the single migration case (A5b) is typed-stopped to an owner gate, and rollback is a git revert preserving audit history

31 predicates map 1:1 to fixtures and edges at 100 percent coverage with negative cases (invalid transitions, mutated evidence, same-digest loop, mutated derivation input); 3 fixtures executed offline with output readbacks and 28 first-implementation commitments recorded as COMMITTED_NOT_RUN, never as executed evidence

the executor-supply contract binds goal, DoD, plan, checklist, tests, allowed and forbidden scope, stop conditions, and reachable blocking transitions; closure requires maker-history-external audit; queue IDs, ACKs, and green CI are excluded from terminal evidence
